## What it is

Boîtier de dérivation à **deux** Wago 221-423 debout, un contre chaque face courte. Le compartiment central est réduit au minimum (6,5 mm) et rempli par un **carré** M3 collé au fond et aux deux murets. Un aimant 8×3 mm centré dans le canal devant le carré. Couvercle `couvercle_2w`.

## Design notes

Same standing 221-423 orientation as `boitier_4w`: 8.3 mm edge on the 2 mm rails, body against the back wall, wires through the slotted wall. Two end bays sized to `wago + jeu` (8.6 mm) with a 0.84 mm muret on the inner side of each. Leftover `longueur` is the square boss side (default 6.5 mm = `pilier_diametre`); the square fills that gap against the back wall so it bonds to both murets.

Default inner 25.4 × 32 mm, outer 28.6 × 35.2 × 25 mm. Screw hole at the square centre (centred in X, in Y on the square). Magnet well on the same X, in the channel — centred without stacking on the boss. Slot floor shared with `boitier_4w`: floor + rails + 5 mm.

A free-standing round boss centred in the box would be weaker than one fused to the slotted wall; the square that fills the middle and bonds to the back wall plus both murets is the strength answer without needing the slotted face.

Bambu Studio: export STL from `print/build/`.

## Don't

- Do not put two magnet wells on this part. One centred well in the channel is enough.
- Do not stack the magnet well under the square on the same XY. The screw hole would open the well; keep the magnet in the channel in front.
- Do not shrink the middle below `pilier_diametre` (6.5 mm). That is the square side and the M3 material around the hole.
- Do not go back to a round boss fused into the slotted wall on this part. The square in the middle is the 2w closure.
- Do not park leftover length inside the end bays. End bays stay at 8.6 mm; the middle absorbs `longueur` and becomes a wider square if raised.
- Do not thicken the 0.6 mm magnet floor for the min_wall default.
- Do not restore the old fixed 10 mm slot height. Use `fente_dessus_rail`.
- Same floor / rail / polish / M3 rules as `boitier_4w`.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```
